rows.note: This is the all-purpose word for a slide-out storage drawer in a cabinet or piece of furniture.

example.english: I put all the clothes in the drawer.
example.jyutping: ngo5 baai2 saai3 di1 saam1 jap6 gwai6 tung2 laa3

rows.note: Use 畫家 for a person whose main artistic work is drawing or painting, rather than for a furniture drawer.

example.english: My friend is a drawer who often draws comics.
example.traditional: 我朋友係畫家，成日畫漫畫。
example.jyutping: ngo5 pang4 jau5 hai6 waa2 gaa1 seng4 jat6 waa2 maan6 waa2

rows.note: Use 酒保 for the barman serving or drawing drinks from a bar tap.

example.english: The drawer draws beer for customers.
example.jyutping: zau2 bou2 bong1 haak3 jan4 laai1 be1 zau2
